finding.text: The table isn't "cheapest first" — it sorts by price-per-token ratio (×Sonnet), not by what a run actually cost, so Claude Sonnet ($0.377/run) sits above Claude Opus ($0.294/run) even though Opus was cheaper here — shot-1200.png, the three "(control)" rows; `models.mjs` sorts on `xSonnet` before `mean_cost`.

Sonnet's price used for the whole table is $3.00 in / $15.00 out, not the $2 in / $10 out the brief names — "Sonnet is $2 in and $10 out per 1M tokens." This also skews every ×Sonnet column, since all of them divide by the same Sonnet rate — shot-1200.png, "Claude Sonnet (control)" row; `ANTHROPIC_PRICE_PER_TOKEN["claude-sonnet-5"]` in `models.mjs`.

No `result.md` in the task folder — the brief asks for five to ten plain lines on what was built, what works, what doesn't. The minion's own log stops at "starting"; the landing commit says its turn died reading an image mid-check, so nothing ever got written.

This review's own `diff.patch` and `shots/` are for a different page entirely (the quick-fix-sandbox bold-heading tweak), not for this task. I read the real diff and shot the real page straight from the worktree (`C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/lt2-cheap`, commit 85311581) to do this review — a reader who trusts the files in this folder as-is would review the wrong change.

A free model with a measured $0 run still shows "<$0.001" in the $/run column instead of "free" — shot-1200.png, "nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free" row. Minor, and it's the page's existing `fmt_usd` formatter, not new code from this diff.
